intro: This Privacy Policy explains how Pronix collects, uses, stores, and shares personal information when you visit our website, create an account, or use our real estate investment platform.
section1Body: Pronix operates a digital real estate investment platform. For privacy-related questions, contact us at {{email}} or through the Contact page on this website.
section2Body:
We may collect information you provide directly, such as your name, email address, phone number, and messages submitted through forms.

We may also collect account and verification details needed to operate co-ownership and investment workflows, as well as technical data such as device type, browser, approximate location, and pages visited.
section3Body:
We use personal information to:
• Provide and improve the Pronix platform
• Respond to inquiries and support requests
• Process applications, reservations, and investment documentation
• Communicate product updates and service notices
• Maintain security, prevent fraud, and meet legal obligations
section4Body: Depending on your location, we process personal data based on one or more of the following: your consent, performance of a contract, our legitimate interests in operating and securing the platform, and compliance with applicable law.
section5Body:
We do not sell your personal information. We may share data with trusted service providers who help us host infrastructure, process communications, verify identity, or deliver platform features — only as needed to provide those services and under appropriate safeguards.

We may also disclose information when required by law, regulation, or valid legal process.
section6Body: We retain personal information only as long as needed for the purposes described in this policy, or as required by law. We apply administrative, technical, and organizational measures designed to protect personal data against unauthorized access, loss, or misuse.
section7Body:
Subject to applicable law, you may request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, and you may object to or restrict certain processing. You may also withdraw consent where processing is based on consent.

To exercise these rights, contact {{email}}. You may also lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
section8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last updated” date at the top of this page will change when we do. Continued use of Pronix after an update means you acknowledge the revised policy.
